Quick Reflexes.name: Quick Reflexes
Quick Reflexes.description:
⚡ You react faster: a step ahead on the draw, the dodge and the sprint.

🎯 Good for anyone who needs to move first.
📋 Requires level 16 and Speed 13.

📈 Grants: Speed +1
Quick Reflexes.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's reaction speed has sharpened: they move first when a fight starts, catch falling objects and clear the space before a blow lands. Show it in quick hands and fast first steps. Limits: it is human reflex refined by training, not a speed Quirk; it gives no extra actions and still loses to an attack they cannot see coming.
